title: Add an array
summary: Fortran: Add an array. Replace 4 with 5.
introduction: sum adds the values in an array. It is a built-in array operation.

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Add an array
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: values(3) = [2, 3, 4]
write(*,'(I0)') sum(values)
end program lesson

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: sum returns a result; it does not change the array.
